remedy.title: Neutralize the Fire-Water Conflict
remedy.description: NE is the water/spiritual zone, so a fire-element room here is a serious dosh. Relocate the kitchen if the floor plan allows. If not, place a copper Vastu pyramid in the NE corner, avoid red/orange décor, and keep the space free of clutter.

notes: Considered one of the most damaging kitchen placements in classical Vastu.

remedy.title: Restore the Spiritual Zone
remedy.description: NE should remain open and lightly used; sleeping here disrupts clarity and health. If relocation isn't possible, sleep with the head towards the South, use minimal/light furniture, and keep the NE corner uncluttered.

notes: Ishanya corner - the traditional and most auspicious placement for a Puja room.
Agni corner - the ideal placement for the kitchen and the cooking stove.

remedy.title: Cool the Fire-Air Conflict
remedy.description: SE combines fire and air energy, which can cause irritability and conflict for occupants. Use cool blues/greens instead of red, avoid mirrors facing the bed, and place a heavy Earth-element object (e.g. a stone showpiece) in the SW corner of the room.

remedy.title: Shield From Kitchen Fire Energy
remedy.description: Keep the puja unit against the room's East or North wall, away from direct exposure to the SE corner's fire energy, and avoid sharing a wall with the kitchen stove where possible.
